job.title: Junior UI Engineer (Micro-frontends & Design Systems)
job.description: OmniRetail (Bengaluru) builds high-scale omni-channel e-commerce systems. We are seeking a Junior UI Engineer passionate about design systems, Storybook, module federation, and CSS architecture. You will help maintain our shared React component library used across 5 consumer web applications.

pool.text: Design Systems with Storybook: documented 30+ accessible components with props and usage examples
Tailwind & CSS Modules: built composable component primitives with zero style leakage
Webpack Module Federation: understood concepts of remote containers and shared dependencies
Component Accessibility (a11y): implemented WAI-ARIA authoring practices for modal and tabs
AuraUI: standalone open-source React component library published to private Verdaccio registry
B.Tech Computer Science, PES University, Bengaluru, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.8/10
CI/CD with GitHub Actions: automated chromatic visual regression testing on every pull request
Golang microservices: built gRPC user service with Protobuf schemas

NPM package management: configured package.json exports, semantic release, and TypeScript declarations
MongoDB aggregation pipelines: optimized complex nested group-by queries
Rollup & Vite bundler configuration: configured tree-shaking and dual ESM/CJS build targets
